lines.text: There's a kind of tired that comes from waiting on the same miracle for years, watching everyone else get there first.
You stop expecting your turn. You just learn the excuses by heart.
Then one question breaks through the noise you've gotten used to: do you even want this to change?
Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
Healing didn't wait for him to reach the water. It met him standing still.
Whatever you've been waiting beside, you don't have to wait there anymore.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Wilt Thou Be Made Whole?
story: A weary figure waits beside a still, mist-grey pool at dawn, lifts into warm breaking light at a quiet question, then rises and walks forward into open blue-gold daylight carrying the mat that used to hold him down - the healing at Bethesda, met before he ever reached the water.
